# pvecli sdn subnet

Manage SDN subnets.

## remove

Detach a subnet from a vnet. A vnet cannot be removed while it has one.

```text
pvecli sdn subnet remove [CIDR] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `CIDR` | Subnet to detach, in CIDR form. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-vn`, `--vnet VALUE` | Vnet the subnet belongs to. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |

## add

Attach a subnet to a vnet, optionally with a gateway, SNAT and DHCP.

```text
pvecli sdn subnet add [CIDR] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `CIDR` | Subnet in CIDR form, e.g. 10.0.30.0/24. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-vn`, `--vnet VALUE` | Vnet to attach the subnet to. |
| `-gw`, `--gateway VALUE` | Gateway address. |
| `--snat` | Masquerade outgoing traffic. |
| `--dhcp-range VALUE` | DHCP range as start-ip:end-ip. |
| `--dhcp-dns VALUE` | DNS server handed out by DHCP. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
